data.name: 三国耕战奇缘
data.detailed_description:
After the release and launch of "Three Kingdoms: Warfare and Destiny", it will enjoy permanent free updates.

After the release of "Three Kingdoms: Warfare and Romance", the game will have permanent free updates. The author will continue to update the gameplay, collect players' opinions and suggestions. As the author himself is also a passionate fan of the Three Kingdoms, he has always wanted to create a game that reflects his inner thoughts about the Three Kingdoms. I sincerely hope that everyone will support us! Any suggestions can be left as comments, contacted through the official customer service, or communicated by joining the QQ group.


About the Game

Three Kingdoms: Tale of Farming and War

A humble peasant. A small patch of land. In an age of chaos, will you survive… or rise against fate?

Three Kingdoms: Tale of Farming and War is an open-ended social survival sandbox RPG powered by large-scale AI models. This is not a game where you begin as a legendary warlord, nor one where you command thousands of troops from the very start.

This time, you travel back to the war-torn Three Kingdoms era as an unknown commoner living at the foot of the vast mountains.

You have no noble bloodline, no divine weapon, and no chosen-one destiny. All you have is a broken hut, a barren field, your own two hands, and the will to survive in a ruthless age.

You may live honestly: farm, chop wood, fish, hunt, trade, and slowly build a life from a single grain of rice and a single copper coin.

Or you may step into the dark currents of society, forming connections, spreading rumors, framing rivals, bribing officials, and climbing your way upward through schemes and ambition.

Will you become a quiet farmer guarding your land?
A wealthy village landlord?
A streetwise scoundrel?
A hidden power broker manipulating local politics?
Or one day, a self-made warlord whose name echoes across the land?

In this AI-driven dynamic Three Kingdoms society, there is no fixed script and no single ending. Every choice you make may change your life, your village, your town, and perhaps even the fate of the realm.

🌾 Farming: Survive the Chaos, One Meal at a Time

In an age of war, survival is never easy.

You must face hunger, poverty, illness, bandits, wild beasts, and the looming threat of conflict. Before dreaming of glory, you must first learn how to stay alive.

Venture deep into the mountains to chop wood, gather mushrooms, collect herbs, and hunt animals. The forest is full of opportunity, but also danger. A harmless-looking mushroom may be poisonous. A quiet mountain path may hide bandits, beasts, or worse.

Clear wasteland, plant crops, raise livestock, fish by the river at dawn, and carry your harvest to town before sunset. Sell wild game to taverns, timber to craftsmen, herbs to doctors, or store grain for the next famine.

This is not just a survival meter. It is a living world filled with the everyday struggles of ancient life: food, money, weather, seasons, market prices, neighbors, and human relationships all shape your fate.

🎭 Scheming: Be an Honest Farmer… or a Ruthless Scoundrel

Honest farming is one path. But in chaotic times, honesty is not always rewarded.

In Three Kingdoms: Tale of Farming and War, you may live as a hardworking villager — or unleash your inner troublemaker.

Jealous of a neighbor’s wealth?
Sneak into his fields at night, steal his crops, destroy his tools, or even set fire to his property.

Want to ruin a rival?
Collect dirt on NPCs, spread rumors, plant false evidence, and confront them in court through intense accusations and verbal battles.

With enough evidence, eloquence, connections, and timing, you may even send an innocent person to prison.

But remember: you are not the only one capable of schemes.

NPCs can hold grudges.
They can investigate.
They can doubt you.
They can fight back.

If you frame someone today, you may be framed tomorrow.
If you destroy a field tonight, the entire village may turn against you next year.
A humble villager you once offended may one day gather allies and return for revenge.

There is no absolute good or evil in this world — only choices, and the consequences that follow.

🧠 Living Society: Every NPC Has a Mind of Their Own

The game features an AI-driven dynamic NPC society system. Every person you meet is more than a scripted character standing in place and repeating lines.

Each NPC has their own personality, desires, memories, wealth, relationships, and goals.

Some are timid and only wish to protect their families.
Some are greedy and easily bribed.
Some are loyal and will remember your kindness.
Some are cunning, smiling to your face while plotting behind your back.

NPCs remember what you do.

A villager you helped during a famine may risk his life to save you years later.
A merchant you cheated may hire killers to hunt you down.
A rumor you casually started in a tavern may ignite a family feud.
A blacksmith, hunter, clerk, guard, or trader you befriend in town may later become a crucial ally when you join the army, build a business, buy influence, or fight for power.

The entire society evolves around your actions.

Hatred spreads.
Favors accumulate.
Rumors grow.
Factions form.

You are not simply completing quests.
You are living in a world that remembers you.

⚔️ War and Power: From Village Nobody to Warlord

Once you have gained enough wealth, reputation, and connections, the larger and more brutal world of the Three Kingdoms begins to open before you.

You may join the army as a lowly soldier and earn military merit through courage and strategy.
You may remain in the local region, build your own influence, bribe officials, befriend powerful clans, and control trade routes and grain supplies.
You may recruit the brothers who once fought beside you and form your own faction.
You may support puppet officials, manipulate county politics, spread rumors among the people, slander rivals, and turn street gossip into political warfare.

But power always comes with danger.

Choose the wrong side, and your home may be confiscated.
Offend a powerful family, and you may become a wanted criminal.
Lose a political struggle, and everything you built may collapse.
Yet even then, defeat is not the end.

You can flee back into the mountains, gather your remaining followers, become an outlaw lord, and begin again.

In this age of chaos, as long as you are alive, there is always a chance to rise once more.

🏮 A Three Kingdoms Story for the Common People

Three Kingdoms: Tale of Farming and War is not only about heroes and battles. It is about the countless ordinary people struggling to survive beneath the shadow of history.

Farmers, hunters, widows, blacksmiths, merchants, county officials, guards, wanderers, bandits, deserters, landlords, refugees — they are not background decorations. They are people trying to live, just like you.

You may cooperate with them, use them, save them, betray them, or destroy them.

You may become their benefactor.
You may become their enemy.
You may become the name they curse in the dark.

Your path is not fixed.

You can become:

A peaceful mountain farmer
A sharp-minded market trader
A shameless village scoundrel
A generous local patron
A ruthless hidden manipulator
A decorated battlefield veteran
A mountain outlaw king
A political mastermind shaping the realm from behind the scenes

Every harvest, trade, argument, lie, alliance, and betrayal becomes part of your life in this chaotic world.

Your Three Kingdoms Begins with a Barren Field

No one is born a hero.
And no one is destined to remain a nobody.

In Three Kingdoms: Tale of Farming and War, you decide how a lowly commoner survives, rises, and changes his fate in an age of war.

Will you guard your small field and live a quiet life?
Will you step into the world of schemes and power?
Will you be swallowed by the times as an unnamed peasant?
Or will you walk out from the mountains and become a name remembered by all?

This Three Kingdoms story does not begin in a palace.
It does not begin on a battlefield.

It begins with your first meal, your first field, and your first choice.

Add Three Kingdoms: Tale of Farming and War to your wishlist and follow the latest development updates.
Your life in the age of chaos is about to begin.

data.short_description: A Three Kingdoms sandbox RPG driven by smart AI! Start as a peasant to farm, fish, and hunt. Or play dirty: sabotage crops, frame NPCs, and slander officials. In this dynamic world where every NPC thinks and plots, will you stay a farmer or rule the land?

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 / 11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core 2 Duo E8400 或 AMD Athlon 64 X2 5600+（2核2.5GHz）
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX2060
  • Storage: 20 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: The basic game content can be run smoothly, but when the population exceeds 2000 or the map size is large, the frame rate may drop. The update interval for NPC AI will be appropriately reduced.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10/11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-6100 或 AMD Ryzen 3 1200（4核3.0GHz+）
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX3070
  • Storage: 50 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Supports over 3000 NPCs across the entire map being active simultaneously, with multi-power war calculations, store management and other systems running concurrently without any lag. The large map scrolls smoothly.
